dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, smooth 2D geometric narrowing of the lateral margins from the mid-dorsal region toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Asymmetrical lateral protrusion visible on the left margin at the anterior third of the body length, contrasted by a more linear taper on the right margin.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; high median pixel intensity across the dorsal surface with minimal shading.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low spatial frequency; minimal localized dark-pixel clusters, primarily limited to faint shadowing along the lateral-posterior edges.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse; no sharp contrast gradients between pigmented and depigmented regions.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Presence of multiple faint, light-colored linear streaks (rake marks) oriented longitudinally on the mid-dorsal surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Superficial linear scarring (rake marks) distributed across the central dorsal plane.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinct, circular dark-pixel aperture representing the blowhole at the anterior apex.
